description: Search the grocery catalogue of Schnäppchen Jäger (schnaeppchenjaeger.zzd.ch, a free Swiss price comparison by zzd) across Migros, Coop, Lidl, Aldi, Denner and Volg, plus Aligro's weekly promotions. Returns products with pack price, price per unit, offer flag, the date each price was read, and a link to each product's comparison page. Prices are the shops' online prices, not branch shelf prices. Counts as one search of the site's free daily allowance (5 a day per connection without an account; calls through Claude's connectors share 300 a day). Each product links its comparison page.

lang.description: Language of names and links. Default de.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'Vollmilch', 'Butter 250g'. German product names match best.

sort.description: Default relevance; unit-price puts the cheapest per kg/litre first.

name: search_grocery_prices
title: Search Swiss grocery prices (Schnäppchen Jäger)
